_note: Hand-curated. perHour = rough completions per hour including lobby/wait time, rounded down. max = largest count offered (clue stacks are capped in game). detail = extra sentence added to the description (keeps the task itself short enough to be a title). twist = optional harder rule used from the given tier upward (minTier: standard|hardcore|extreme).

twist.rule: No healing of any kind: bring no food and drink no rejuvenation potions.
twist.fail: You die, or heal by any means inside the Wintertodt prison.

minigames.name: Guardians of the Rift
minigames.task: Complete {n} game{s} of Guardians of the Rift

twist.rule: The Great Guardian must win every game you join.
twist.fail: A game you are in ends in defeat.

twist.rule: Every game must be a win.
twist.fail: A game you are in is lost.

minigames.name: Castle Wars
minigames.task: Play {n} full game{s} of Castle Wars

twist.rule: Personally capture the enemy flag at least once.
twist.fail: You finish your games without a flag capture to your name.

minigames.name: Soul Wars
minigames.task: Play {n} full game{s} of Soul Wars

twist.rule: Your team must win at least half of the games.
twist.fail: Your team wins fewer than half of your games.

minigames.name: Last Man Standing
minigames.task: Play {n} game{s} of Last Man Standing

twist.rule: Win at least one of them outright.
twist.fail: You finish your games without a single win.

minigames.name: Fishing Trawler
minigames.detail: A trip only counts if the boat stays afloat.

twist.rule: No deaths. The volcano does not accept excuses.

minigames.name: Pyramid Plunder
